thread:
maria-support: Escalation from customer: after last night's cluster rollout in ap-sg, they're seeing degraded text-gen outputs — short, repetitive responses and more hallucinations. Only observed from SG cluster. Putting it here for eng-runtime to triage. Request IDs in the ticket.

aj-eng-runtime: Thanks. Can you paste a minimal repro (redacted keys), the customer-observed output vs expected, and which model/version + region header they used?

maria-support: Repro (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \\
  -H \"X-Region: ap-sg\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\n    \"model\": \"rwd-3b-v2\",\n    \"input\": \"Summarize this payment failure and suggest fixes:\n\n txn: 0x8a...\n status: fail code 402\",\n    \"max_tokens\": 150\n  }'

Observed (customer):
\"Payment failed. Try again later. Error 402.\" — one-liner, generic.

Expected (historical): detailed summary with likely root causes, field breakdown, and remediation steps.

Relevant request IDs: r_5f7a2c (report), r_5f7a9d (customer repro), r_5f7b01 (support repro).

maria-support: They ran the same request to us-east-1 and got a rich answer. Only ap-sg shows the regression.

kai-oncall: Metrics show ap-sg experienced a post-deploy jump in batching window and per-token latency at 03:15 UTC. Avg batch window ~95ms (baseline ~18ms). KV cache miss rate spiked concurrently. Suggests a batching/cache interaction.

aj-eng-runtime: Can you paste serving log excerpts for those request IDs (kernel selection + scheduler traces)?

maria-support: Logs (sanitized):

```
[2026-03-15T03:16:12Z] r_5f7a9d | route=ap-sg-01 | model=rwd-3b-v2 | kernel=quant-int8 | batch.window=96ms size=12 | kv_cache=miss
[2026-03-15T03:16:12Z] r_5f7a9d | route=us-east-2 | model=rwd-3b-v2 | kernel=float16 | batch.window=22ms size=3 | kv_cache=hit
[2026-03-15T03:16:12Z] scheduler | ap-sg-01 | applied policy=dynamic-batch-scheduler-v2
[2026-03-15T03:16:12Z] kernel-selector | ap-sg-01 | chosen=quant-int8 (reason=low-memory fast-path)
```

aj-eng-runtime: Noted — ap-sg is picking a quantized int8 kernel and larger batches. If KV cache misses increase with bigger batches, prefix recomputation or truncation could be changing generation fidelity.

priya-cs: Customer also noted higher token billing — repetitive filler tokens inflated usage. They attached billing delta aligned with the timeframe.

aj-eng-runtime: What's the hardware in ap-sg? Kai?

kai-oncall: ap-sg runs mixed A30/A10G. We rolled dynamic-batch-scheduler-v2 cluster-wide at 2026-03-15T03:15:00Z; us-east still on scheduler-v1.

aj-eng-runtime: Action items: collect full serving logs for r_5f7a9d and r_5f7b01 from /var/log/redwood/serving/ap-sg/*.log (include kernel-selection traces); capture kernel runtime config and quant profiles used for rwd-3b-v2 on ap-sg hosts; attempt repro with scheduler-v1 forced to see output diff.

maria-support: Logs attached to ticket. Quick local test forcing scheduler-v1 returned the richer expected output. Diffs attached.

aj-eng-runtime: Two working hypotheses: 1) scheduler-v2 increases batching window causing KV cache churn which, combined with quant-int8 fast-path, reduces fidelity; 2) scheduler-v2 routing/thresholds are causing quantized variant selection for certain token-length distributions on ap-sg due to available memory profiles.

kai-oncall: Proposed mitigation: rollback scheduler-v2 to scheduler-v1 on a canary subset (ap-sg-01..04). I can run rollback but need eng approval.

aj-eng-runtime: Approved for canary subset. Kai, rollback ap-sg-01..04 and run the repro. Post new request IDs.

deploy-bot: rollback scheduler-v1 applied to ap-sg-01..04 at 2026-03-15T03:42:11Z by kai-oncall (job 7739). Monitoring 15m.

kai-oncall: Rolled back. Reproduced: new request r_5f8c11 returned the verbose expected answer. Latency returned to baseline and KV cache hit rate recovered on canary nodes.

aj-eng-runtime: Good. Engineering follow-ups: reproduce at scale under scheduler-v2 to validate; add telemetry on kernel-selection and batching heuristics; add a guard to avoid choosing quant-int8 fast-path when prefix_length > 64 or kv_cache_miss_rate > 0.2; prioritize a patch for scheduler-v2.

priya-cs: Informing customer of canary rollback and asking them to re-test. :pray:

maria-support: Updating ticket and asking for their confirmation. Also note: customer SDK sometimes sends X-Region as \"ap-sg-2\"; please ensure routing normalizes region IDs.

aj-eng-runtime: Will check region normalization and scheduler thresholds. Filing ENG-INC-20260315-02 for tracking and assigning owners. If you see similar reports in other regions, tag this thread. :eyes:
